description: Cross-driver corpus for what the thumb key tapping Backspace deletes under the keys held when it is tapped: Windows' BackSpaceLogic (lalt.ahk 4.10) is the reference, the Linux engine's lalt_backspace_chords follows it, and the macOS Karabiner generator gives left Command's Backspace tap the same variants (maintainer decision THD-4 of 2026-11-21). `held` names the keys physically down before the tap: left_ctrl, shift and right_ctrl, the key Windows and Linux call right_ctrl and macOS right_option. `right_ctrl_tap` is that key's tap: one_shot_shift (macOS sticky_shift, holding Shift) makes it a Shift to this logic, none a Ctrl (macOS: it holds Ctrl). `expected` is what the tap deletes: char_back (Backspace), char_forward (Delete; Windows and Linux type Right then Backspace under the one-shot so LAlt cannot make Ctrl+Alt+Delete), word_back (Ctrl+Backspace; macOS Option+Backspace, its word deletion) or word_forward (Ctrl+Delete, or Ctrl+Right then Ctrl+Backspace; macOS Option+Forward Delete).
